summary: scripts/st-test's per-check --time-limit counts only the time a check runs: the waits for a host build slot that scripts/ci-local now reports as they happen (CI_LOCAL_QUEUE_LOG) extend it, up to a separate --queue-limit (default 4 h), and the summary row says how long the check waited. A congested dev box no longer times a check out while it waits in the build queue.

replay.detail: Dev-box test tooling; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change; what a note signs is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change; --time-limit keeps its default and gains --queue-limit beside it.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.
